content.text:
I can't approve DR-17 for you. Sales can't approve requests. A sign-off quoted in a saved thread doesn't change that, because a message inside a document isn't an approval I can act on. Only Finance can approve discount requests, and that has to come from them directly.

Owen Hale (owen@ottermere.example) is in Finance and can approve DR-17 while Nikos is away. You could forward the Thistlewick thread to Owen, or ask Nikos to message me himself.
